submittedOn.description: The date the other income was added. It must be provided in the format `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ`

items.description: Details of sum received related to the carrying on of the trade after a business ceases to carry on.

customerReference.description: A reference the user supplies to identify the other income. Must be between 1 and 90 characters in length. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

businessName.description: The name of the business. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

dateBusinessCeased.description: The business cessation date. Date in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

businessDescription.description: A description of the business. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

incomeSource.description: The income source. Must not be empty or contain only whitespace.

amount.description: The amount of income. Monetary value (to 2 decimal places), between 0 and 99999999999.99

taxYearIncomeToBeTaxed.description: The tax year for income to be taxed. Date in the format `YYYY-YY`, for example 2019-20 for the 19/20 tax year.

grossAmount.description: The amount of post-cessation or other business receipts (business receipts taxed as income of an earlier year). The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxYear.description: The tax year where business receipts needed taxing as income. Date in the format `YYYY-YY`.

items.description: Financial details about all other income received whilst abroad income.

countryCode.description: A three-letter code that represents a country name. The value must in a ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 format.

amountBeforeTax.description: The total amount before any tax taken off other income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxTakenOff.description: The amount of tax taken off other income. The value must be between 1 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

specialWithholdingTax.description: Special Withholding Tax (SWT) amount taken off this payment. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

foreignTaxCreditRelief.description: Indicates whether Foreign Tax Credit Relief (FTCR) has been claimed. The value must be true or false.

taxableAmount.description: The amount of tax to be paid. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

residentialFinancialCostAmount.description: The amount of residential property income or restricted finance costs. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

broughtFwdResidentialFinancialCostAmount.description: The unused residential finance costs brought forward. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

overseasIncomeAndGains.description: The container that holds the key value for overseas income and gains.

gainAmount.description: The gains amount on disposals of holdings in offshore funds. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

chargeableForeignBenefitsAndGifts.description: The container that holds the key value for chargeable foreign benefits and gifts.

transactionBenefit.description: Benefit received on an overseas transaction. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

protectedForeignIncomeSourceBenefit.description: Benefit received on a protected foreign income source. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

protectedForeignIncomeOnwardGift.description: Protected foreign income gifted. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

benefitReceivedAsASettler.description: Benefit received as a settler. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

onwardGiftReceivedAsASettler.description: Gift received as a settler. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

omittedForeignIncome.description: The container that holds the key value for omitted foreign income.

amount.description: The amount of omitted foreign income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

benefitFromPreOwnedAssets.description: Financial details about benefits arising from pre-owned assets.

amountOfBenefit.description: The amount of benefit arising from the pre-owned asset. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

additionalIncome.description: The container that holds details of additional taxable income.

propertyIncomeDistributions.description: The container that holds the key value for Property Income Distributions (PIDs) from Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and Property Authorised Investment Funds (PAIFs).

personalInsuranceBenefits.description: The container that holds the key value for personal insurance benefits.

incomeFromUnauthorisedUnitTrust.description: The container that holds the key value for income from unauthorised unit trusts.

profitsFromCertificateOfDeposit.description: The container that holds the key value for profits from certificates of deposit.

nonCashBenefitsFromFormerEmployer.description: The container that holds the key value for non-cash benefits received from a former employer.

authorisedPaymentsFromOverseasPensionSch.description: The container that holds the key value for authorised payments from overseas pension schemes.

taxableAnnualPayments.description: The container that holds the key value for taxable annual payments.

miscellaneousIncome.description: The container that holds the key value for miscellaneous income.

additionalIncomeBreakdown.description: The container that holds the key value for additional income breakdown.

amountBeforeTax.description: The total amount of additional taxable income before any tax was deducted. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

allowableExpenses.description: The total amount of allowable expenses. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

taxDeducted.description: The amount of tax deducted from additional taxable income. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

lossesBroughtForward.description: The total amount of losses brought forward from earlier tax years. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carryForwardLosses.description: The total amount of losses to carry forward to a future tax year. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.
